question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. **Impecunious**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Wealthy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

 
• The word **"Impecunious"** means having little or no money; being poor. (निर्धन, गरीब)

 

 
• **Example: **After losing his job, he found himself in an impecunious situation, struggling to pay his bills.

 

 
• **"Wealthy"** refers to someone who is rich, affluent, and has an abundance of money or valuable possessions. (धनी, संपन्न)

 

 
• **Example: **The wealthy businessman donated generously to the charity, helping thousands of people.

 

 
• Hence, the opposite of **'Impecunious'** is **'Wealthy'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2: Wealthy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Insolvent **(दिवालिया): Unable to pay debts owed by a person or company.

 

 
• **Example:** The company declared itself insolvent after years of financial struggles.

 

 
• **Indigent **(निर्धन): Extremely poor and lacking the basic necessities of life.

 

 
• **Example:** The indigent community received aid from the local government to improve their living conditions.

 

 
• **Penniless** (कंगाल): Having no money at all; completely broke.

 

 
• **Example:** After spending recklessly, he was left penniless and unable to afford even basic needs.
